name: theme.aftermath_reload_cleanup_mcw
description: Full-scene aftermath/reload cleanup probe: reload the current McWilliams dev-harness world after a thematic fight or siege, advance a short window, save, and audit that live-world, NPC, monster, horde, and turn metadata remain inspectable instead of duplicating or stalling silently.

steps.label: post_reload_aftermath_settle
steps.expected_visible_fact: post-reload gameplay screen from the current McWilliams world after a prior thematic handoff/save; this is load evidence plus aftermath footing

steps.label: preflight_aftermath_npc_snapshot
steps.expected_visible_fact: saved overmap NPC snapshot is recorded before the aftermath window so duplicate/missing NPCs can be compared in the report

steps.label: preflight_aftermath_game_turn_baseline
steps.expected_visible_fact: saved game-turn baseline is recorded before the aftermath wait

steps.label: disable_safe_mode_before_aftermath_window
steps.expected_visible_fact: safe mode is off before the aftermath window

steps.label: wait_5m_aftermath_settle_window
steps.pre_menu_expected_visible_fact: alarm/wait mode menu is visible, then Wait a while is chosen before the duration menu
steps.expected_visible_fact: the reloaded aftermath world advances a bounded 5-minute window without obvious prompt deadlock

steps.label: audit_player_save_mtime_before_aftermath_save
steps.expected_visible_fact: saved-player mtime baseline is recorded before the aftermath save/writeback

steps.label: open_save_prompt_after_aftermath_window
steps.abort_reason: screen text did not prove the case-sensitive Save and quit prompt before confirming aftermath save

steps.label: confirm_save_after_aftermath_window
steps.expected_visible_fact: uppercase Y confirmed save/writeback after the aftermath window

steps.label: audit_player_save_mtime_after_aftermath_save
steps.abort_reason: saved-player mtime did not advance after confirming the aftermath save

steps.label: audit_saved_game_turn_after_aftermath_window
steps.abort_reason: saved turn counter did not prove the aftermath window actually advanced

steps.label: audit_aftermath_npc_snapshot_after_save
steps.expected_visible_fact: saved overmap NPC metadata is captured after the aftermath save for manual duplicate/missing/survivor review

steps.label: audit_aftermath_bandit_live_world_snapshot
steps.expected_visible_fact: saved bandit_live_world metadata is captured after reload/advance/save for manual active-group and site-state review

playtest_rubric.primary_question: After reload, did the scene settle into believable aftermath state, or did actors duplicate, freeze, forget hostility, or keep impossible pressure?

evidence_contract.claim: a previously saved thematic fight/siege aftermath can reload, advance, save, and leave inspectable state for manual duplicate/stall review
evidence_contract.load_only_verdict: load proof only / inconclusive for aftermath cleanup
evidence_contract.failure_rule: No aftermath cleanup credit unless reload, bounded time passage, save/writeback, turn delta, NPC snapshot, and bandit_live_world snapshot are all present.
